messages:
Marta (Marketing): FYI team - targeting launch Mon 2026-11-08 10:00 PT. Need final changelog blurb, docs anchor, and webinar RSVP. Can eng confirm canary sizing + timing? :wave:
Theo (Eng): We can support. Embargo lift = 2026-11-08 10:00 PT. Which model string to publish? We used rwd-infer-v2-micro in the canary run.
Marta (Marketing): Use rwd-infer-v2-micro. Changelog draft: https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-999. Please paste final one-line + 2 bullets here. No quantization claims.
Samir (Docs): I'll create /docs/release-2026-11-08 and anchor /docs/release-2026-11-08#launch-notes. Will include a short upgrade note and a link to the routing config. ETA EOD.
June (Growth): Staging RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/nov-launch?utm_campaign=nov_launch. Will swap to prod when docs are live. Need speaker blurb and CTA copy.
Theo (Eng): Perf highlights: p50 gen 70ms (was 88ms), p95 300ms (was 410ms). Token cost down ~9%. CSV uploaded to PR. Can marketing use "~20%" hero line?
Marta (Marketing): We'll say "up to ~20% latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token compute cost". Can eng approve?
Theo (Eng): Approved. Rollout proposal: 10% at T+0, 40% at T+25m, 100% at T+2h. Ops, please add rollback gates.
Pri (Ops): OK on ramp. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% sustained 5m OR sustained p95 >2.5x baseline for 10m. Adding runbook steps and oncall list.
Marta (Marketing): Changelog one-liner draft: "Routing and KV-cache fixes to reduce latency and per-token cost for hosted inference." Blog bullets: "Smarter routing lowers average token latency by up to ~20%" and "KV-cache hotfix improves cold-cache tail latency and hosting compute spend."
Samir (Docs): Adding those bullets into the docs. Also adding a short "no action required" migration note for Dedicated customers. Will post final URL when live.
deploy-bot: Canary schedule set: 10% -> 6141600599 (T+10m), 40% -> 6141602399 (T+40m), 100% -> 6141604199 (T+2h). Healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
June (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers for a short demo of faster inference and the new routing controls." CTA: "Register now - limited seats."
Pri (Ops): We'll stream canary metrics to #eng-sre and tag this thread if thresholds hit. If rollback needed, we'll follow the runbook and notify marketing here.
Theo (Eng): I'll push final changelog text to PR by 16:00 PT and link it here.
Marta (Marketing): Thanks all  tagging @Theo @Samir @Pri. Post any changes in this thread. :thumbsup:
